title: Reported Speech: Changing Time and Place Words — Quiz 128
content:
## Reported Speech: Changing Time and Place Words

Fill the gaps with suitable adverbs and demonstratives.

### Lesson focus

1. He said, “This is my horse.”
2. He said, “I received this letter two days ago.”
3. He said, “I'm glad to be here this evening.”

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
